nodes.name: @silvia-odwyer%2Fphoton-node@0.3.4.patch
nodes.summary: Bun patch for photon-node 0.3.4 that lets opencode's compiled binary redirect the image-processing WASM asset via globalThis.__OPENCODE_PHOTON_WASM_PATH instead of the module-relative path.
nodes.languageNotes: Bun patchedDependencies apply unified diffs to node_modules at install time; this one patches the wasm-bindgen loader to accept an injected path.

nodes.name: @standard-community%2Fstandard-openapi@0.2.9.patch
nodes.summary: Bun patch for standard-openapi 0.2.9 making convertToOpenAPISchema tolerate external URL $refs by falling back to the remaining schema properties or a plain string type.

nodes.name: install-korean-ime-fix.sh
nodes.summary: User-facing installer that clones the patched opencode fork and builds a binary fixing Korean/CJK IME last-character truncation on Enter in Kitty and other terminals (issue #14371).

nodes.name: solid-js@1.9.10.patch
nodes.summary: Bun patch applying the upstream Solid.js fix #2046 so the first computation during a transition also sets the committed signal value, replicated across all four dist bundles (dev/prod, ESM/CJS).
nodes.languageNotes: The same two-line runComputation fix is duplicated in dist/dev.js, dist/dev.cjs, dist/solid.js and dist/solid.cjs because the package ships prebuilt bundles.

nodes.name: beta.ts
nodes.summary: Beta-branch merge orchestrator that lists PRs labeled beta, merges them sequentially into the beta branch, and delegates conflict resolution to an AI agent (opencode run with gpt-5.3-codex) before validating with typecheck and the single-file compiled build.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses Bun's tagged-template shell ($`...`) for subprocess control, and verifies pushes by comparing git tree hashes of beta against origin/dev rather than trusting exit codes.

nodes.name: commentOnPR
nodes.summary: Posts a formatted failure comment on a PR via gh pr comment explaining why it was excluded from or failed during the beta merge batch.

nodes.name: cleanup
nodes.summary: Aborts any in-progress merge and hard-resets the local beta branch back to origin/beta before retrying a PR merge.

nodes.name: typecheck
nodes.summary: Runs bun typecheck inside packages/opencode, returning whether it succeeded while streaming its output.

nodes.name: build
nodes.summary: Runs the self-contained single-file compiled build (script/build.ts --single) in packages/opencode as a beta-branch smoke gate.

nodes.name: commitSmokeChanges
nodes.summary: Commits any working-tree changes left behind by agent-driven fixes during smoke validation, then re-runs typecheck and build to confirm the committed state is clean.

nodes.name: install
nodes.summary: Regenerates dependency state by removing bun.lock and node_modules then running bun install, used when bun.lock conflicts must not be hand-merged.

nodes.name: fix
nodes.summary: Builds a detailed conflict-resolution prompt (merged/pending PR context, bun.lock and deletion rules, typecheck instructions) and spawns opencode run to resolve the in-progress merge, then verifies no unmerged files remain.

nodes.name: smoke
nodes.summary: Final deterministic smoke gate: runs typecheck and the single-file build after the whole batch, and on failure spawns an agent run instructed to fix merge-caused issues without committing.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: Orchestrates the full beta batch: fetch open beta-labeled PRs via gh, merge each into beta (routing conflicts to fix/cleanup/commentOnPR), push, verify remote tree hashes, run the smoke gate, and push again if the agent changed anything.

nodes.name: changelog.ts
nodes.summary: CLI wrapper that regenerates UPCOMING_CHANGELOG.md by spawning opencode run --command changelog with from/to/variant arguments, optionally reprinting the result or suppressing output unless the run fails.

nodes.name: check-updates.ts
nodes.summary: Monorepo-wide dependency update scanner: discovers every workspace package.json, filters pinned versions, queries the npm registry for the latest same-major release, and reports or applies (--apply, --apply --install) available minor/patch upgrades.
nodes.languageNotes: Deliberately skips non-pinned specifiers (catalog:, workspace:, ^, ~, github:, npm:, file:) so only exact-pin dependencies are rewritten.

nodes.name: findPackageJsonFiles
nodes.summary: Recursively collects all package.json files under the repo while skipping node_modules, dist, .git and other noise directories.

nodes.name: fetchLatestVersion
nodes.summary: Fetches a package's dist-tags from the npm registry with a timeout, returning the latest tag or null on failure.

nodes.name: fetchVersionsInRange
nodes.summary: Fetches the full npm version list for a package and returns the newest non-prerelease release within the given major, used to propose safe minor/patch bumps.

nodes.name: dedupe-opentui.ts
nodes.summary: Maintenance script that re-points package-local @opentui symlinks (including inside opentui-spinner's .bun entries) at the root hoisted copies so Bun resolves a single module instance across the workspace.

nodes.name: relink
nodes.summary: Replaces a package-local symlink with a fresh relative symlink targeting the root hoisted copy, skipping silently when no root link exists.

nodes.name: duplicate-pr.ts
nodes.summary: Boots an embedded opencode server via the SDK's createOpencode and prompts the duplicate-pr agent with a message plus an optional attached file, printing the agent's final text response.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: Parses CLI args, assembles text/file prompt parts, creates a session on the embedded server, sends the duplicate-pr agent prompt with a 2-minute timeout, and prints the returned text part.

nodes.name: format.ts
nodes.summary: One-liner developer script that runs Prettier with --ignore-unknown --write across the whole repository.

nodes.name: generate.ts
nodes.summary: SDK regeneration pipeline: runs the sdk/js build script, dumps the openapi.json schema from the dev server, and formats the result via script/format.ts.

nodes.name: close-issues.ts
nodes.summary: GitHub maintenance job that finds issues in anomalyco/opencode with no activity for 60 days and closes them via the REST API, first posting an explanatory comment with reopen guidance.

nodes.name: close
nodes.summary: Posts the stale-issue notice comment and then closes a single issue through the GitHub REST API.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: Searches for open issues updated before the 60-day cutoff and invokes close on each one, logging progress.

nodes.name: hooks
nodes.summary: POSIX shell installer that writes a .git/hooks/pre-push hook running bun install (best-effort) followed by bun run typecheck so pushes are blocked on type errors.

nodes.name: publish.ts
nodes.summary: Root release publisher: rewrites the version field in every workspace package.json, rebuilds the SDK, delegates to the per-package publish scripts, then commits/tags/pushes the release, syncs versions back to dev, and un-drafts the GitHub release.

nodes.name: prepareReleaseFiles
nodes.summary: Rewrites the version string in every discovered package.json, then runs bun install and the SDK build script so all artifacts carry the release version.

nodes.name: raw-changelog.ts
nodes.summary: Deterministic changelog generator: pages the GitHub compare API between two refs, classifies commits by product area (Core/TUI/App/SDK/Extensions) from touched paths and conventional-commit type, drops reverted commits, computes first-time contributors, and renders the grouped markdown release notes.
nodes.languageNotes: Mixes gh api/git plumbing with pure data shaping; team members (from .github/TEAM_MEMBERS) and bots are excluded from contributor credit.

nodes.name: diff
nodes.summary: Pages through the GitHub compare API between two refs collecting commit shas, author logins, and messages into a flat list.

nodes.name: reverted
nodes.summary: Pairs commits with their later Revert "..." counterparts and removes both from the changelog candidate set.

nodes.name: commits
nodes.summary: Builds the changelog commit list: fetches the compare diff, enriches each commit with product areas inferred from git diff-tree file paths, and filters out reverted commits.

nodes.name: contributors
nodes.summary: Maps external contributor logins to the commits they authored, excluding team members and bot accounts from credit.

nodes.name: published
nodes.summary: Fetches the body of an already-published GitHub release and extracts its contributor-thanks section for reuse.

nodes.name: thanks
nodes.summary: Renders the first-time contributor thanks lines, combining freshly computed contributors with names already credited in previous releases.

nodes.name: format
nodes.summary: Groups commits into area sections and conventional-commit types, then renders the final markdown release notes with compare links and the thanks section.

nodes.name: release
nodes.summary: Tiny bash wrapper that dispatches a release by running gh workflow run publish.yml with a bump type argument (default patch).

nodes.name: sign-windows.ps1
nodes.summary: PowerShell release step that signs Windows binaries with Azure Trusted Signing (TrustedSigning module, RFC3161 timestamping); safely no-ops outside GitHub Actions or when Azure credentials are absent.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses a ValueFromRemainingArguments param to accept arbitrary file paths and pins the TrustedSigning module to version 0.5.8 for reproducibility.

nodes.name: stats.ts
nodes.summary: Analytics job that aggregates GitHub release asset downloads and npm download counts for the opencode packages, rewrites the README stats table, and ships the metrics to PostHog.

nodes.name: sendToPostHog
nodes.summary: Posts an analytics event to the PostHog capture endpoint under the download distinct_id, warning instead of failing when no API key is configured.

nodes.name: fetchNpmDownloads
nodes.summary: Queries the npm downloads API over a deliberately over-wide date range and sums the daily download counts for a package.

nodes.name: fetchReleases
nodes.summary: Pages through the GitHub releases API collecting tag names and per-asset download counts, with a small delay between pages to respect rate limits.

nodes.name: calculate
nodes.summary: Sums asset download counts across releases and groups them into per-platform statistics entries.

nodes.name: save
nodes.summary: Parses the existing README stats table, computes week-over-week deltas for GitHub, npm, and total downloads, rewrites the row, commits via git, and emits PostHog events.

nodes.name: upgrade-opentui.ts
nodes.summary: Bumps @opentui/core, @opentui/keymap, and @opentui/solid across every workspace package.json and the root catalog, preserving range prefixes (^, ~, >=) and skipping catalog:/workspace: references.

nodes.name: editDeps
nodes.summary: Rewrites the @opentui dependency entries in a package.json dependencies object, keeping each entry's existing range prefix style.

nodes.name: editCatalog
nodes.summary: Sets the @opentui entries in the root package.json catalog to the exact target version.

nodes.name: version.ts
nodes.summary: CI release bootstrap: emits version/tag/release outputs to GITHUB_OUTPUT and creates a draft GitHub release, generating changelog notes via script/changelog.ts for stable builds or an empty beta draft for preview channels.

nodes.name: project.md
nodes.summary: Design spec draft for running sessions across multiple projects and worktrees, sketching a project-scoped REST API (/project/:projectID/session/...) with message, revert, permission, and file endpoints.

nodes.name: session.md
nodes.summary: V2 spec note justifying removal of the dedicated POST /session/:sessionID/init route, which is only a wrapper around the existing /init command flow, to avoid Session.initialize-style special cases.

nodes.name: todo.md
nodes.summary: V2 architecture roadmap listing eleven workstreams with owners: replacing Hono, a new data mode, agent loop and compaction reworks, plugin API, config/auth/model-database/provider/event redesigns, and hot-reloadability.

nodes.name: sst-env.d.ts
nodes.summary: Auto-generated SST ambient declarations enumerating every infra resource (Cloudflare Workers, KV, R2 buckets, SolidStart console, secrets) so sst resource references are fully typed in application code.
nodes.languageNotes: Header marks it as machine-generated by SST; it augments the Resource interface inside the 'sst' module declaration and should never be hand-edited.

nodes.name: sst.config.ts
nodes.summary: SST infrastructure entry point: defines the opencode app on Cloudflare with Stripe/PlanetScale/Honeycomb providers, production protect/retain policies, and dynamically imports the app, console, enterprise, and monitoring stacks.
